{{Quote|Courage is nothing but terror that holds its ground a minute longer.|Chief Sergeant Saens Sukko|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Saens Sukko''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[chief sergeant]] who served during the [[Subterra Period]]. During the [[Waymancy Storm]] conflict of [[7811 BBY]], he helped collapse the [[Clowse Glowstack]] structure of the Republic's enemy, the [[Signatories of Waymancy]]. The Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] later thanked Sukko for attending a service dedicated to the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Chief Sergeant Sukko was among those who scaled Mittoblade's magnetic cliff, where he helped trigger the collapse of the Clowse Glowstack despite losing both legs to a Doshan raider.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
Saens Sukko served as a [[chief sergeant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Armed Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="EGTW" /> during the [[Subterra Period]],<ref name="Subterra">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}} establishes Saens Sukko was active in [[7811 BBY]] and [[7786 BBY]], both of which fall within the [[Subterra Period]] per ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.</ref> which lasted between [[8000 BBY]] and [[7000 BBY]]. At one point, Sukko remarked on the close relationship between bravery and fear.<ref name="EGTW" /> During the [[Waymancy Storm]] conflict<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of [[7811 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> a [[Mittoblade's magnetic cliff|magnetic cliff]] was located on<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Mittoblade system/Legends|Mittoblade system]]</ref> celestial body [[Mittoblade/Legends|Mittoblade]] and was the site of the structure known as the [[Clowse Glowstack]], which was associated with the Republic's enemy in the war, the [[Signatories of Waymancy]]. A group of Republic agents, including Sukko, scaled the cliff, and the chief [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] assisted in initiating the [[Collapse of the Clowse Glowstack|collapse]] of the Clowse Glowstack, although in the process the [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] lost both of his [[Limb/Legends|legs]] to a raider from<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the world [[Doshan]].<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

In [[7786 BBY]], Sukko was present at a service dedicated to the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]]. At a speech delivered during the ceremony and transmitted to several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] thanked in particular the chief sergeant for his presence at the service and went on to note the events at Mittoblade as one of the heroic moments of the war.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This chapter had to be cut down quite a bit&mdash;there was some cool stuff on propagandists, including the infamous Ryloth Resa; a War Portrait of Mar Tuuk; and a planetary profile of Metalorn that had some neat details for Marvel fans. As a nod to that lost stuff, I attributed this chapter's quote to Sergeant Sukko, a character from Dan Wallace's cut material about the Waymancy Storm.|Jason Fry, on the writing process of ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''|<ref name="Fry6">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22588801475/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-6|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 6}}</ref>}}
[[File:Essential_Guide_to_Warfare-cover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Saens Sukko was created for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.]]
Saens Sukko was created for the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> He was originally meant to be mentioned in a section of the book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]], but it was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> As a reference to both that fact and the removal of material describing, among other subjects, the [[Propaganda/Legends|propagandist]] "[[Ryloth Resa]]" and<ref name="Fry6" /> the capable [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and tactician<ref name="Sith">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?]]''</ref> [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]], Fry attributed to Sukko the lead quote of the book's chapter on the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Fry6" /> The section featuring Sukko was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut — The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
